finalText:
The bug is the `<` comparison in `low_stock`, which excludes items exactly at the threshold, even though the docstring says "at or below." Fixing it to `<=`.
Fixed. `low_stock` in `inventory/core.py:38` used `item.quantity < threshold`, so items exactly at the threshold were left out. The docstring says "at or below," so I changed the comparison to `<=`. The one-line change is the only edit.
